title: Indian-language speech and pedagogical-meaning qualification
whatBuilt: Reproducible held-out evaluation-corpus REGISTRY with independent interface/input/source/output language + script identity, modality, device context (noisy/low-bandwidth) and pedagogical meaning
Rights/leakage checks: missing consent/license refused; a held-out case that overlaps training source/content is REJECTED (leakage_detected)

Versioned per-case/route evidence ledger: ASR/TTS/model/prompt/interface versions, recognition + critical-semantic errors, intelligibility/pronunciation, uncertainty, latency/cancellation, per-task cost; authors record evidence only
Preapproved qualification thresholds; coverage is REVIEWER-GATED
Dataset/model language COUNTS never establish coverage - covered only with held-out evidence AND a qualified human reviewer decision (accept/reject tri-state)

provenEndToEnd.rightsClearedCorpus: consent/license required; held-out leakage from training source rejected; clean held-out + train cases register
provenEndToEnd.versionedEvidence: author records outcomes with versions, error/cost/cancellation; reviewer role cannot record (not_owner)
provenEndToEnd.countsNeverCoverage: counts-only and evidence-without-reviewer both report not covered; unqualified author cannot decide coverage
provenEndToEnd.reviewerGated: thresholds-met + reviewer accept -> covered; reviewer reject recorded -> not covered (reviewer_rejected); pending -> reviewer_decision_pending

verification.speechqualificationCheck: npm run speechqualification:check -> 4/4 tests pass (compile tsconfig.speechqualification.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Native prerequisites per ticket: KAN-29, KAN-65, KAN-84 (all in Testing). This builds the REPRODUCIBLE QUALIFICATION FRAMEWORK (registry, leakage checks, evidence ledger, reviewer-gated coverage). It does NOT run real ASR/TTS/provider comparisons or declare product voice coverage; qualified reviewers and a licensed/consented held-out corpus with actual provider runs remain required before any voice enablement. No hosted/provider/load/commercial/coverage gate is claimed closed by this work.
